messages:
sara-nguyen: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert — Stripe webhooks for prod are returning 429/401 spikes and Stripe account flagged for quota enforcement. Some customers report slow billing syncs and auth failures. I'm paged. Investigating.

jon-ortega: jumping in — can you paste sample logs + headers? Are these 429 rate limits or "account_disabled" style?

sara-nguyen: sample from logs:
```
[2026-11-02T12:01:05Z] POST /webhook/stripe 429 Stripe: "rate_limit_exceeded"
id=evt_3K... customer=acct_123
headers: Stripe-Request-Id: req_abc, x-stripe-livemode: true
```
Getting a handful of 401s too with `account_inactive` in the body.

kevin_chu: I'm seeing similar in infra traces — spikes align with our billing job retries at :55. Might be burst amplification. Trying to throttle retries and add jitter.

lina-garcia: support queue has 12 customers impacted, mostly mid-market. They're seeing delayed invoices and some access token failures on checkout flows.

jon-ortega: mitigation plan: 1) pause retry loop on billing service for 1 minute 2) apply short client-side backoff 3) route webhooks to secondary region if available 4) open Stripe ticket w/ logs. I'll push a canary config now.

sara-nguyen: doing handoff — jon you're primary; I'm off in 30. Notify next oncall afterwards. Update PagerDuty with the action.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by jon-ortega (oncall)

jon-ortega: pushed patch to billing service to cap retries: 
```bash
# temporary env override
BILLING_MAX_RETRIES=2
BILLING_RETRY_BASE_MS=500
```
Rolling in prod canary (1% traffic) now.

kevin_chu: also adding header to our webhook client to surface merchant id and retry-window so Stripe can correlate. Sent request to Stripe support: https://dashboard.stripe.com/support/cases/CASE-98765

stripe-status: Update: Reports of degraded webhook delivery are being investigated by Stripe. No official quota enforcement notice yet. https://status.stripe.com/incidents/stripe-xyz

jon-ortega: can confirm canary reduced 429s by ~70% for the canary shard.

lina-garcia: telling affected customers we're actively mitigating and offering a workaround to re-run failed syncs via UI. Draft message posted to #support-templates.

sara-nguyen: Handing off — @kevin_chu will take over in 30m for extended mitigation and comms. I'll post status to #incidents and runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/stripe-webhook-quota>

kevin_chu: will monitor for next 4h. Next steps: request temporary quota increase with Stripe or implement delayed job batching; prepare rollout of caching layer for webhook events.

jon-ortega: stripe replied: they are applying "account-level rate limiting due to unusual volume" and requested we identify high-volume merchants. Uploading logs now.

lina-garcia: support asked for ETA — we estimated 2 hours for full recovery and 15-30m for partial relief after scaling canary. Pushing update to customers now.

kevin_chu: putting action items: 1) batch retries 2) token caching 3) alert rule: webhook 429 > 5m 4) postmortem owner: kevin. Assigning in Jira.

sara-nguyen: :thumbsup: Good. Leaving notes in the thread. I'm OOO now — thanks team.

jon-ortega: thanks — will update if anything from Stripe. :shipit:

stripe-status: Update: Rate limiting persists; working with customer (Redwood) — no ETA yet.

kevin_chu: Logged followup with infra to avoid retry storms from scheduled jobs. Adding circuit breaker. Will prepare retrospective.

lina-garcia: closing loop with customers who accepted manual re-syncs; remaining ones flagged for automatic retry once backoff completes.

jon-ortega: last check 12:28 UTC — errors trending down, still some 429s. Keeping watch. last ping before handoff: 1785001289"
